proposed_widenings.name: MagicItemRecord + magic_item family
proposed_widenings.justification: UnitRecord has no magic_item kind. The v4 taxonomy lists magic_item_root as a source atom, but types.ts has no MagicItemRecord, no MagicItemMechanics family, and no mechanics header shape for magic items. The Horn of Valhalla cannot be expressed as SpellRecord, ClassFeatureRecord, or MasteryRecord without lying about what it is.
proposed_widenings.evidence: You can take a Magic action to blow this horn. In response, warrior spirits from the plane of Ysgard appear in unoccupied spaces within 60 feet of you.

proposed_widenings.name: RestResetCadence: days_N
proposed_widenings.justification: The horn recharges after 7 days — not on a short or long rest. RestResetCadence has no variant for calendar-day recharge windows. This is structurally distinct from rest-gated resources.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Once you use the horn, it can't be used again until 7 days have passed.

proposed_widenings.name: ClassFeatureEffect (or MagicItemEffect): create_companion
proposed_widenings.justification: The horn's primary effect is summoning N Berserker warrior spirits that act as companions. The v4 atom inventory includes create_companion but the TypeScript surface types.ts has no create_companion variant in ClassFeatureEffect (only grant_extra_action and heal_hp). A magic item mechanics family would need this effect variant.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Each spirit uses the Berserker stat block and returns to Ysgard after 1 hour or when it drops to 0 Hit Points.

proposed_widenings.name: MagicItemVariants: type-indexed subconfigurations
proposed_widenings.justification: The Horn of Valhalla is a single item with four named subtypes (Silver, Brass, Bronze, Iron), each having a different spirit count (2–5) and a different use requirement. No existing surface shape supports a single item record with indexed variant configurations.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Four types of Horn of Valhalla are known to exist, each made of a different metal. The horn's type determines how many spirits it summons, as well as the requirement for its use.

proposed_widenings.name: MagicItemMechanics: use_requirement (proficiency/training prerequisite)
proposed_widenings.justification: Brass requires proficiency with all Simple weapons, Bronze requires training with all Medium armor, Iron requires proficiency with all Martial weapons. There is no surface mechanism for item use requirements gated on proficiency or training.
proposed_widenings.evidence: If you blow the horn without meeting its requirement, the summoned spirits attack you.

notes: Primary blocker is structural: magic_item is not a valid UnitRecord kind in types.ts. The tracer's switch on unit.kind is exhaustive over 'spell' | 'class_feature' | 'mastery' — any magic_item JSON would fail typecheck before reaching the tracer. Four secondary gaps (7-day recharge, create_companion surface type, variant-by-type, proficiency prerequisite) are also missing and would require widening even once the top-level kind is added.
